assessment.nobel_worthiness: A transformative framework for correlated-electron materials, giving a practical connection between many-body theory and measured electronic spectra.
assessment.attribution: Georges and Kotliar represent dynamical self-consistency; Vollhardt its infinite-dimensional foundation. The supplied trio supports a coherent theoretical citation.
assessment.maturity: Decades of use and experimental comparison make the central contribution mature.
uncertainties: The packet does not document the full collaborator history or delimit the accuracy of approximate material implementations.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Identified a new class of electronic matter through topology and linked it to robust boundary transport. The combination of conceptual clarity and material realization is outstanding.
assessment.attribution: Kane and Mele represent classification and prediction; Molenkamp experimental quantum-spin-Hall establishment. The credited trio is well matched to a focused citation.
assessment.maturity: The core phase has a substantial, independent experimental history.
uncertainties: The packet supplies no detailed contribution chronology. A prize should specify the time-reversal-invariant achievement rather than absorb every later topological phase.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Spin-dependent tunnelling became both a fundamental transport phenomenon and a powerful device principle, with enduring impact on magnetic technology.
assessment.attribution: Moodera and Miyazaki represent the room-temperature discovery; Parkin a major MgO-junction contribution. A joined configuration is plausible.
assessment.maturity: The underlying effects and device implementations are long-established and reproducible.
uncertainties: The packet lacks information on parallel MgO contributors and their priority. Original tunnelling discovery and crystalline-barrier advancement may need different allocation.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Prediction and observation of magic-angle correlated matter turned twist into a controllable material-design parameter, opening a new experimental approach to interacting electrons.
assessment.attribution: MacDonald and Bistritzer represent the flat-band theory; Jarillo-Herrero the correlated-insulator and superconducting discoveries.
assessment.maturity: The material platform and principal correlated phases are established; microscopic pairing theory remains unsettled.
uncertainties: The citation should not claim a settled mechanism of superconductivity. Parallel discovery and enabling device-fabrication credit require historical review.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Quantized Hall conduction driven by magnetism rather than an applied field is a sharply defined advance in topological quantum transport.
assessment.attribution: Dai and Fang represent materials prediction; Xue realization in magnetic topological films. The three roles are complementary.
assessment.maturity: The integer effect is established and has sustained years of detailed transport and materials work.
uncertainties: Full theoretical priority and independent precision evidence are not supplied. Practical temperature limitations are not resolved by the packet.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Correcting electron-optical aberrations removed a major measurement barrier and made quantitative atomic-scale materials investigation possible.
assessment.attribution: Rose represents corrector design, Haider instrument realization and Urban the decisive materials demonstration. This is a coherent enabling invention.
assessment.maturity: The technique is mature and widely used; its instrumental improvement is directly measurable.
uncertainties: The packet lacks exact priority documentation and the boundary between transmission and scanning implementations; these must be checked before fixing the citation.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Controllable optical lattices made strongly correlated models experimentally accessible, offering direct tests beyond conventional calculation.
assessment.attribution: Zoller represents the theoretical model realization; Bloch and Greiner foundational experiments and microscopy. This subset joins theory to measurement.
assessment.maturity: The Mott-transition and lattice-simulation platform have extensive independent experimental development.
uncertainties: Esslinger is also credited. A citation centered on fermionic Hubbard physics could change the appropriate three-person allocation.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Atomically thin intrinsic magnets opened a new regime for spin interactions and electrically tunable material behavior, directly relevant to theoretical magnetism.
assessment.attribution: The three credited experimental leaders plausibly represent complementary discoveries in thin magnetic crystals.
assessment.maturity: The principal existence of magnetic order is established, with a substantial period of follow-up; device implications remain developing.
uncertainties: The packet does not specify which compounds, thicknesses and independent confirmations establish each contribution. Anisotropy and dimensionality must be stated precisely rather than suggesting a violation of general no-order results.
